patch_notes.text: Your own d1-2B runs on the NPU: one-pass decisions over text, pictures and video, with boxes. The Flash checkpoints and the Flash engine are unchanged.
Your own LFM3-1.7B runs on the NPU, and a long request to an NPU model no longer waits for a whole generated reply. The Flash checkpoints and the Flash engine are unchanged.

Two requests decoding at once are about 20% faster and three about 9%, a JSON schema and strict tools work on requests with images, and the NPU engine names an XRT that is too old. The Flash checkpoints are unchanged.
